notes.title: Major Update - v0.9.44
notes.notes:
Hello there! 

This is a rather large update with lots of fixes and some new features that hopefully helps to improve gameplay and quality of life in the game. Most of this is a result from all of the amazing feedback we received from playtesters and from the last SteamFest. We're very grateful for it! Here are the main changes:

[list]
[*] Updated each floor to have a single Hovercam (as opposed to one in each room). This means it's now possible to fly around before and after aligning a Biotrace. It's also possible to use the Hovercam to find a few notes and things in places the player can't go.
[*] Each Hovercam has a "prove you're not a robot" image puzzle with it.
[*] Each of the Audio Fragments has a short puzzle that gradually increases in difficulty. It's not that difficult really, but hopefully helps to provide the sense and agency that you are actually defragmenting it.
[*] In the Floorplan it's possible to drag and drop both the Hovercam and Lightstick to any room. This way you don't have to track down where you last set one of them.
[*] The menu screens no longer use a virtual mouse on PC. It uses your direct mouse input.
[*] The player's hands no longer look weirdly stretched.
[*] All of the doors automatically open and close, both as the player and when flying the Hovercam.
[*] Some of the furniture in the game has been updated to reflect the life the character's live.
[/list]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/xMDuXbU.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/xMDuXbU.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/FPrJGj8.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/FPrJGj8.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/kFjFOTd.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/kFjFOTd.png[/img][/url]

There are also bug fixes and minor tweaks to improve the feel of things. Please let me know if there are any issues and any feedback is greatly appreciated!

Larry

notes.title: Update for build 0.9.9.0
notes.notes:
Hello! Here are the changes for this pretty significant update:

* Added a basic floorplan layout to the Player Tablet.
* Updated the tablet so that the room the player is in is a soft blue.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vVswinu.jpg[/img]
* Fixed issue with the Hovercam image not loading the correct image when left-clicking it.
* Updated so the player controls their own RFI LightStick.

The change to the LightStick is a major change but we feel giving the player complete control is essential to feeling like a proper investigator, especially in this sci-fi setting.

For now, to use it simply hold the LMB or Controller A/X button down for 0.25 seconds. It'll show a marker that you can move around. Release the LMB and it'll place the LightStick right there.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kkWtBQe.jpg[/img]

We still have lots to iron out to get this fully featured but please let us know if you run into any problems or have any feedback please let us know on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/ctMSXrwYfU]https://discord.gg/ctMSXrwYfU[/url]

All the best,

Larry and Mat

notes.title: Update notes for 0.9.8.1
notes.notes:
Hello there! Pretty significant update today with the more important items near the top:

* Updated the Exit button to map to the right mouse button by default. Feels much better for both left and right handed players.
* The Persons of Interest are all visible right at the start of the game.
* Fixed some object pop-in/pop-out issues in Zooey's bedroom.
* Fixed typos in the phone/laptop messages.
* Updated the background music to change more often after aligning Biotraces.
* Added a "Progress" section to the Tablet to view an overall progress for the game. This will become the "Case Progress".
* Fixed some issues with some dates on some documents.
* Updated the inspection mechanic to track how long it takes to analyze. The result is visible in the Physical Evidence Board as well as an average at the end of the game.
* Added commenting by Inspector Sommerset for some objects for world building.
* Fixed some issues with the performance of lights in bedrooms.
* Added more Datasearch Descriptions for a lot more objects.
* Minor updates to the HUD (alignment, placement, animation, etc).
* Fixed the prescription dates to be correct (they were off a year). Also prescriptions show up in the Digital Evidence Board.
* Fixed Biotrace collision particles to trigger by any game object in the world (i.e. drawers, hovercam, etc).
* Added subtle screen shake and joystick vibration entering the Hovercam.

Our discord is here for feedback, bugs, suggestions, etc: [url=https://discord.gg/HhepjD9]https://discord.gg/HhepjD9[/url]

Thanks for playing! 

Larry and Mat

notes.title: Update notes for build 0.9.8
notes.notes:
Hello,

This build introduces a new fast and simple datasearch mechanic to learn more about various objects in the game from the viewpoint of the AI. Essentially the AI quickly searches data online about whatever object the player is looking at and presents it to the player.

About 55 objects have been updated so far. More to come.

Thanks - Larry
